payload.note: Bosonic ground-state lift checkpoint: the exact flat-potential inverse pseudodeterminant has a positive finite-graph lift by two real commuting Gaussian fields pinned at a root. The root cofactor identity det K^(o)=det'(K) Omega_o^2/||Omega||^2 makes a uniform rooted mixture exact; after the ground-state transform the fields are pinned GFFs with conductances w_xy Omega_x Omega_y and killed-walk Green covariances. The superficially adjacent VRJP/H^{2|2} localization law is not the BT law: it carries determinant power +1/2 and a cosh edge energy, versus BT power -1 and Gaussian centered-potential confinement, so direct theorem import is obstructed without changing the measure. This opens a BT-specific annealed random-conductance/Witten route but does not decide the actual lowest-mode or H^-1 moment, continuum, Born, Krein, or Lorentzian gates.
